class.name: SpacetimeDBClient
class.brief_description: Client for connecting to a SpacetimeDB database from Godot.

method.name: connect_to_database
method.description: Opens a WebSocket connection to a SpacetimeDB server. [param host] is the server URI (e.g. "ws://localhost:3000"), [param database] is the database name or identity, and [param token] is an optional authentication token for reconnecting with the same identity.

method.name: disconnect_from_database
method.description: Closes the WebSocket connection to the database.

method.name: poll
method.description: Advances the connection by polling the WebSocket for incoming messages. This must be called every frame (e.g. in [code]_process[/code]) for the client to receive data.

method.name: call_reducer
method.description: Invokes a server-side reducer by name, passing an optional array of arguments.

method.name: subscribe
method.description: Subscribes to one or more SQL queries. The server will push the initial matching rows and keep the local cache updated in real time.

method.name: get_table
method.description: Returns the local [SpacetimeDBTable] cache for the given table name, or null if the table has not been seen.

method.name: has_table
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a table with the given name exists in the local cache.

method.name: get_table_names
method.description: Returns the names of all tables currently in the local cache.

method.name: register_table
method.description: Pre-registers a table by name so its schema can be configured before data arrives.

method.name: is_connected_to_database
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the client is currently connected.

method.name: get_identity
method.description: Returns the [SpacetimeDBIdentity] assigned by the server after connecting.

method.name: get_auth_token
method.description: Returns the authentication token received from the server. Save this for reconnecting with the same identity.

method.name: get_connection_id
method.description: Returns the connection ID assigned by the server for this session.

signal.name: connected
signal.description: Emitted when the connection is fully established and the server has provided an identity and token.

signal.name: disconnected
signal.description: Emitted when the connection is closed.

signal.name: connection_error
signal.description: Emitted when a connection error occurs.

signal.name: identity_received
signal.description: Emitted when the server sends the IdentityToken message with the full identity, auth token, and connection ID.

signal.name: subscription_applied
signal.description: Emitted when the initial subscription data has been fully loaded into the local cache.

signal.name: reducer_called
signal.description: Emitted when a reducer call result is received. [param status] is "committed", "failed", or "out_of_energy".

signal.name: row_inserted
signal.description: Emitted when a new row is inserted into a subscribed table.

signal.name: row_deleted
signal.description: Emitted when a row is deleted from a subscribed table.

signal.name: row_updated
signal.description: Emitted when a row in a subscribed table is updated.

signal.name: event_received
signal.description: Emitted for every raw message received from the server, useful for debugging or handling custom protocol extensions.

constants.constant: The client is establishing a WebSocket connection.
The client is connected and ready.
Use the JSON text WebSocket protocol (v1.json.spacetimedb).
